isi.lyrics:
Lyric ENHYPEN - The Veiled Truth

Romanization

The lovers who once tried to break a taboo
have now become a taboo themselves.

As if nothing had happened,
the Vampire Pursuit Unit
erased their story from the world,
as though the lovers who fled in the name of desire
had never existed at all…

Nowhere did anyone
dare to speak of their story.

Whether they were cruelly punished
by the vampire society,
or managed to escape
and begin a long new journey, no longer as fugitives…
No one knows how it all ended for them.

And standing before that veiled truth,
we decided to end our pursuit.

After bidding a final farewell
to the lovers we’ve long followed,
the show now turns its attention
to another unsolved mystery.

May their end not be one of ruin.
May luck be on their side, in love.

Lyric ENHYPEN - The Final Moment

Romanization

The horrific reality awaiting the lovers
shattered the afternoon’s calm and engulfed them.

This marked the end of a long escape.
The Vampire Pursuit
Unit eventually tracked them down.

The moment they toasted,
confident they could defy the world
and claim eternity.

As the footsteps of the Vampire Pursuit Unit
drew near,
sharp, relentless, and mocking their love,

all the two could do
was clutch each other’s hands
just a little more tightly,
the same way they always had.

At the very moment their love was
about to be shattered
by the Vampire Pursuit Unit’s blades,
they ironically became one, perfectly united.

The lovers made a final pledge to one another.

Even if engulfed in flames, they would never let go.
Even with broken wings,
they would fly together until the very end.

우리는 더 깊이 들어가 보기로 했습니다.
